images.title: Split the blocks, gather the ones
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the nines and ones tool: 427 split into blocks of nines plus loose ones, the 13 loose ones losing one group of 9 to leave remainder 4.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Place value blocks across the top and a tray of loose ones below.
images.exact_structure: Top row: 4 hundred blocks, each a large teal (#0072B2) block marked 99 with 1 small amber (#E69F00) cube beside it; then 2 ten rods, each a teal (#0072B2) rod marked 9 with 1 small amber cube beside it; then 7 small amber unit cubes. Above the row: 427. Below, one wide tray holding exactly 13 small amber cubes, labelled 13 loose ones: 9 of them inside a reddish purple (#CC79A7) ring, 4 outside it. Beside the 4 outside cubes: remainder 4. Two labels name the splits: 99 + 1 under the first hundred block and 9 + 1 under the first ten rod. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: The loose ones add up to the digit sum; removing nines from them leaves the remainder on division by 9.
